problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of a differentiable convex function f:E→ℝ on a second-countable real Hilbert space. A global minimizer x★ exists with ‖x0−x★‖≤R. Strong convexity and convexity of individual sample functions are not assumed.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: One oracle call at (x,y) returns (g(x,ω),g(y,ω)) using the same fresh sample for both evaluations. Samples are IID across calls, and E[g(x,ω)]=∇f(x). The sample law and g are hidden; no function values or exact gradients are supplied. The extracted budget counts paired calls with a fixed cap.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/StrongGrowthMeanSquaredSmoothConvex.lean: spec.Query, spec.Reply, spec.admissible; LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: IID; LongTails/Template.lean: execute, Convergence.

distinctive_assumptions.label: relative_error
distinctive_assumptions.details: Gradient-relative variance: E‖g(x,ω)−∇f(x)‖²≤Γ²‖∇f(x)‖² for every x, with Γ≥0. Together with unbiasedness this gives E‖g(x,ω)‖²≤(1+Γ²)‖∇f(x)‖². This is a second-moment condition, not a pointwise error bound; no additive noise floor is present.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/StrongGrowthMeanSquaredSmoothConvex.lean: spec.valid; spec.admissible (unbiasedness, variance integrability and inequality).

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Mean-squared smoothness under the shared sample: E‖g(x,ω)−g(y,ω)‖²≤Lbar²‖x−y‖² for all x,y. No samplewise Lipschitz bound is required. The space may be infinite-dimensional. All Params are public, including Lbar>0, Γ≥0, R≥0, ε>0 and x0; the objective, sampling laws and oracle map remain hidden.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a measurable E-valued output X whose objective gap f(X)−f(x★) is integrable and at most ε in expectation for a global minimizer x★. No particular iterate or averaging rule is required.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: E[f(X)−f(x★)]≤ε, taking expectation over the product of algorithm randomness and the IID oracle-seed law. No high-probability or almost-sure accuracy guarantee is requested.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: A structured stochastic convex variant combining gradient-relative variance, mean-squared oracle smoothness and paired shared-sample queries on a potentially infinite-dimensional Hilbert space.

descriptionHtml:
Strong-Growth Mean-Square Smooth Convex Minimization

We consider minimizing a differentiable convex function f:E→R on a separable real Hilbert space E. A given point x0∈E lies within distance R≥0 of a global minimizer x⋆. The oracle returns (g(x,ξ),g(y,ξ)) at a pair (x,y)∈E2, using a shared sample ξ from a probability law p on a measurable space Ω, independently across calls. The estimator g:E×Ω→E is unbiased, with variance bounded by Γ2∥∇f(x)∥2, where Γ≥0, and is mean-square Lipschitz with constant L¯>0. For ε>0, the goal is a measurable output x¯∈E with integrable objective gap satisfying E[f(x¯)−f(x⋆)]≤ε, averaging over oracle and algorithm randomness.

The optimization problem is minx∈Ef(x). The norm ∥⋅∥ is induced by the inner product on E, which is equipped with its Borel sigma-algebra. The algorithm receives E, Ω, L¯, Γ, R, ε, and x0; the objective is accessed through the oracle.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Convexity and initial distance). The function f is Fréchet differentiable everywhere on E, and for every x,y∈E and t∈[0,1], f((1−t)x+ty)≤(1−t)f(x)+tf(y). There exists x⋆∈E such that f(x⋆)≤f(x)for every x∈E,∥x0−x⋆∥≤R.

Assumption 2 (Unbiasedness and strong growth). The map g:E×Ω→E is jointly measurable. For every x∈E, g(x,⋅) is Bochner integrable under p, the squared error ∥g(x,⋅)−∇f(x)∥2 is integrable, and Eξ∼p[g(x,ξ)]=∇f(x),Eξ∼p[∥g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)∥2]≤Γ2∥∇f(x)∥2.

Assumption 3 (Mean-square smoothness). For every x,y∈E, the squared difference ∥g(x,⋅)−g(y,⋅)∥2 is integrable under p, and Eξ∼p[∥g(x,ξ)−g(y,ξ)∥2]≤L¯2∥x−y∥2.

More precisely, the oracle samples form a sequence (ξk)k≥0 of measurable, mutually independent random variables, each with law p. Algorithm randomness is independent of this sequence. At call k, the algorithm may query any pair (x,y)∈E×E and receives (g(x,ξk),g(y,ξk)). Each paired reply counts as one oracle call; both components use the same sample.

After the allotted oracle calls, the output x¯ must be measurable, its objective gap f(x¯)−f(x⋆) must be integrable, and EP[f(x¯)−f(x⋆)]≤ε, where P is the joint law of the algorithm randomness and the oracle sample sequence.

comparisonHtml:
Convex differentiable f on a second-countable real Hilbert space with its Borel σ-algebra; a minimizer x⋆ satisfies ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R. For L¯,ε>0 and Γ,R≥0, a jointly measurable oracle with the stated moments integrable satisfies Epg(x,ξ)=∇f(x), Ep∥g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)∥2≤Γ2∥∇f(x)∥2, and Ep∥g(x,ξ)−g(y,ξ)∥2≤L¯2∥x−y∥2. Each query returns a same-sample pair, with fresh IID samples of law p under P. Target: measurable output y with integrable gap and ∫[f(y(ω))−f(x⋆)]dP(ω)≤ε.

Strong growth with mean-squared smoothness: StrongGrowthMeanSquaredSmoothConvex.
Result Oracle complexity Novelty Limitations
(1) ProximalStormStrongGrowth (Ours) (⋆⋆⋆) (review) O((1+Γ)3/2ℓL¯R2/ε+(1+Γ)2ℓ) pair calls, including batches and warm-up; two gradient evaluations per pair.
(2) Accelerated SGD (Vaswani et al. 2019, Thm. 2); AGNES (Gupta et al. 2024, Thm. 3) O(1+(1+Γ2)LR2/ε) single-point stochastic gradients. On Rd; L may be replaced by the public bound L¯. (1): Rate: Γ3/2ℓL¯ instead of Γ2L for large Γ. Lower total cost if L¯≪ΓL/ℓ2 and ε≪LR2/ℓ2.
With L=L¯ tuning: factor Γ/ℓ for ε≲L¯R2/Γ.		 (1) needs MSS and same-sample pairs; adds (1+Γ)2ℓ overhead. At L¯≍ΓL, loses a logarithmic factor and the additive term. Larger proved constants.
(3) Derived bound (Jain et al. 2018, Thm. 1) O(κκ~[1+log(1+κκ~dLR2ε)]) single-point stochastic gradients. Realizable least squares on Rd, H≻0, finite fourth moments. (1): Scope extends from strongly convex quadratics to convex nonquadratic objectives, without a PL condition. (1) loses linear convergence on this overlap: ε−1/2 instead of logarithmic accuracy dependence.

Abbr: MSS: mean-squared smoothness; PL: Polyak–Łojasiewicz; ℓ=1+log⁡(1+Γ); L≤L¯: gradient Lipschitz constant of f; R: initial-distance bound; Γ: relative-noise level. In (3), f(x)=12E(a⊤x−b)2, b=a⊤x⋆ almost surely, d=dim⁡x, H=Eaa⊤=∇2f, L=λmax(H), κ=C4/λmin(H); C4 and κ~ are the least constants satisfying E[∥a∥2aa⊤]⪯C4H and E[(a⊤H−1a)aa⊤]⪯κ~H. The initial gap obeys f(x0)−f(x⋆)≤LR2/2.

import LongTails.Template
import LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Gradient.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.Convex.Function

open MeasureTheory

namespace LongTails.Setups.StrongGrowthMeanSquaredSmoothConvex

open OracleTemplate

structure Params where
  E : Type
  [normedE : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [innerE : InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [completeE : CompleteSpace E]
  [measurableE : MeasurableSpace E]
  [borelE : BorelSpace E]
  [countableE : SecondCountableTopology E]
  Ω : Type
  [measurableΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
  Lbar : ℝ
  Γ : ℝ
  R : ℝ
  ε : ℝ
  x0 : E

attribute [instance] Params.normedE Params.innerE Params.completeE Params.measurableE
  Params.borelE Params.countableE Params.measurableΩ

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance p := p.E → ℝ
  Query p := p.E × p.E
  Reply p := p.E × p.E
  Output p := p.E
  publicInput p := p
  valid q := 0 < q.Lbar ∧ 0 ≤ q.Γ ∧ 0 ≤ q.R ∧ 0 < q.ε
  admissible q f O :=
    ∃ (g : q.E → q.Ω → q.E) (p : ProbabilityMeasure q.Ω) (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → q.Ω)),
      LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID
        (fun k (ξ : ℕ → q.Ω) => ξ k) (p : Measure _) (P : Measure _) ∧
      O = { Seed := fun _ => q.Ω
            law := P
            answer := fun _ (_, z) ω => (g z.1 ω, g z.2 ω) } ∧
      ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f ∧
      (∀ x, HasGradientAt f (gradient f x) x) ∧
      (∃ xstar, IsMinOn f Set.univ xstar ∧ ‖q.x0 - xstar‖ ≤ q.R) ∧
      Measurable (Function.uncurry g) ∧
      (∀ x, Integrable (g x) p) ∧
      (∀ x, ∫ ω, g x ω ∂p = gradient f x) ∧
      (∀ x, Integrable (fun ω => ‖g x ω - gradient f x‖ ^ 2) p) ∧
      (∀ x, ∫ ω, ‖g x ω - gradient f x‖ ^ 2 ∂p ≤ q.Γ ^ 2 * ‖gradient f x‖ ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ x y, Integrable (fun ω => ‖g x ω - g y ω‖ ^ 2) p) ∧
      (∀ x y, ∫ ω, ‖g x ω - g y ω‖ ^ 2 ∂p ≤ q.Lbar ^ 2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2)
  successful q f output P :=
    Measurable output ∧
      ∃ xstar, IsMinOn f Set.univ xstar ∧
        Integrable (fun ω => f (output ω) - f xstar) (P : Measure _) ∧
        ∫ ω, f (output ω) - f xstar ∂(P : Measure _) ≤ q.ε

end LongTails.Setups.StrongGrowthMeanSquaredSmoothConvex
